drafted_from: tool:keep-trillion-in-your-instructions's row in tools/tell-ais-how-to-act/tool-rows.json, do-work/keep-standing-instructions.mjs, do-work/standing-instructions.mjs, read-data/harness-instruction-files.json and test/standing-instructions.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check whether Trillion's standing instructions are in my Codex instruction file, and tell me what applying them would change before you write anything." It reads the tool's row, then runs it on your computer with harness codex and action inspect.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads and writes one marked block in the harness's own instruction file on the person's computer, and answers a report.
instructions: 1. Say which AI harness it is for (claude-code, codex, gemini-cli, or a hosted app such as chatgpt) and that you want Trillion's standing instructions checked first.

2. The AI reads the tool's row with @workshop-tools tools:list {tool: "tool:keep-trillion-in-your-instructions"}, then runs its command on your computer from the root of the Workshop checkout: write {"harness":"codex","action":"inspect"} to a file and run node tools/tell-ais-how-to-act/do-work/keep-standing-instructions.mjs < that file.

3. Read the report.status: absent (no block yet), present (up to date), outdated (the words changed) or blocked (the markers are broken, nothing is written). Only when you ask for it, run again with action apply (writes or replaces only the marked block) or remove (takes out only the block). Every other byte of the file stays as it was.
4. A hosted app with no file answers status use-host-control and names the setting to put the text in; nothing is written.

worked_examples.title: Ask a hosted app where the standing words go
worked_examples.ask: Put Trillion's standing instructions into ChatGPT for me.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/tell-ais-how-to-act/do-work/keep-standing-instructions.mjs and standing-instructions.mjs (the test 'a hosted app with no file is answered with its own control and never written' runs the same case). The AI runs the row's run command on your computer with this input file: {"harness":"chatgpt","action":"apply","text":"Say what you did in plain words."}. In read-data/harness-instruction-files.json chatgpt is a host-control row, so no file is read or written.
